format.use: Instagram Reel for ATELIER 47 BARBIER, Annecy

brand.logo: the ATELIER 47 BARBIER logo: a circular badge made of two thin concentric brushed-gold rings on matte black; at the top a pair of open gold scissors; the word 'ATELIER' in cream condensed capitals with wide letter spacing; a large bold gold '47' below it; a thin horizontal gold line; 'BARBIER' in cream spaced capitals; and the small gold tagline 'COUPE NETTE · BARBE SOIGNÉE'
brand.price_list: NOS TARIFS — Coupe: Coupe Homme 22€, Dégradé/Fade 25€, Coupe étudiant 20€, Enfant (-12 ans) 15€. Barbe + soins: Barbe 15€, Shampooing 5€, Coupe + barbe + shampoing 38€. @atelier47barbier

global_style.realism: Ultra-photorealistic live-action footage, indistinguishable from a real commercial shot on an ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic 35mm and 100mm macro lenses: true-to-life materials (leather grain and stitching, brushed metal with micro-scratches, veined marble, real glass, real plant leaves with natural imperfections), physically accurate light, shadows and reflections, real-world physics and natural camera inertia, subtle lens breathing, soft halation on highlights, natural film grain. Absolutely no cartoon, illustration, 3D render, CGI or AI-looking artifacts.
global_style.palette: Colors strictly matte black #111111, brushed gold #C9A24B and warm cream #F3EEE3; the only other colors allowed are the natural green of the plants and the green pitch on the TV.
global_style.lighting_and_grade: Moody low-key lighting, deep blacks, warm 2700K golden highlights from brass pendant lamps, slightly desaturated warm cinematic grade identical on every shot, subject razor sharp, soft creamy bokeh.
global_style.set: The ATELIER 47 BARBIER salon in Annecy, an upscale modern barbershop, completely empty of people. Fixed layout, identical in every shot: a tall glass entrance door on the street side; the reception and checkout desk just to the right of the entrance; two black leather barber chairs with gold details facing round gold-framed mirrors along the left wall; the waiting lounge at the back; a row of brass pendant lamps along the ceiling. Materials: matte black walls, cream veined marble floor, dark walnut counters. Lots of lush green plants everywhere: tall monstera and an olive tree in matte black pots, hanging pothos trailing from the ceiling, ferns on the shelves, small plants on the counters. Reception desk in dark walnut: a slim black all-in-one computer whose screen shows a dark booking calendar with gold accents, a black card payment terminal with a glowing screen and a contactless symbol, a black-and-gold framed price list titled 'NOS TARIFS', and behind the desk, backlit on the black wall, the ATELIER 47 BARBIER logo: a circular badge made of two thin concentric brushed-gold rings on matte black; at the top a pair of open gold scissors; the word 'ATELIER' in cream condensed capitals with wide letter spacing; a large bold gold '47' below it; a thin horizontal gold line; 'BARBIER' in cream spaced capitals; and the small gold tagline 'COUPE NETTE · BARBE SOIGNÉE'. Waiting lounge: black leather sofa, two armchairs, a low marble coffee table with two white game controllers and a few TIM DESIGN grooming products, and a large wall-mounted flat TV above a dark walnut TV cabinet on which a white PlayStation 5 console stands upright, its blue-white light glowing softly.
global_style.tv: The TV shows a football video game being played on the PlayStation 5: bright green pitch from the wide broadcast camera angle, small game players running, no readable score, no team or channel logos.
global_style.products: TIM DESIGN is the premium grooming product line sold in the salon: matte black and amber glass bottles and jars with gold caps.

production_rules: Same salon in every shot: identical layout, materials, plants and light (generate the wide shots from one reference image of the salon).
The first frame is already moving with the logo visible: no black or still opening.
Every cut lands exactly on a beat of the music.
Speed ramps on every transition: the shot accelerates just before the cut (100% to 200%) and slows down at the start of the next one.

Transition effects: zoom-in and pull-back with strong motion blur, whip-pans, push-ins through the TV, the price list frame and the phone, 2-frame white-gold flashes, warm gold light leaks, a 3-frame camera shake on the bass drop, blur dissolves.
Product close-ups are the highlight: perfect focus, controlled reflections, premium macro quality, slowed to 70-80% with optical-flow smoothing.
One identical color grade on every shot.
The Instagram moment is perfectly clear: the phone screen is large, steady and sharp, ABONNEZ-VOUS stays readable for the whole 5.5 seconds.
The ending fades to black and loops seamlessly back to the night façade of the first shot.

audio: Dark luxury deep-house instrumental, no vocals, heavy bass drop at 3.5s, fade out over the last 2 seconds. Layered sound design: night street ambience and the door opening, a deep impact on the drop, metallic clicks on the product flashes, the razor ring, a whoosh on every zoom, pull-back and whip-pan, muffled stadium crowd and game sounds from the TV in the lounge shots, a soft beep from the card terminal, a smooth slide when the phone rises, a bright notification ding when ABONNEZ-VOUS appears, a warm low boom under the final logo.
